Combat and equipment

Count research, crafting and ammunition before switching guns

Do not judge a new gun only by its crafting recipe. Check its prerequisite nodes and Scrap research cost, then the weapon components, then whether you have enough ammunition, gunpowder and metal to take it into the field. A gun that you can craft but cannot keep supplied may be less useful for now than one you already know.

Make a three-column checklist: unlock, craft and resupply. Choose a near-term purpose—hunting, exploring or player combat—before choosing a research path. There is no universal best weapon order. Use this site’s recipe and weapon pages to check current client materials, then confirm what your server actually allows.

This guide focuses on the cost of continuing to use a weapon. It does not adopt damage rankings from outside articles that lack comparable test conditions or may describe an older version.
